{{Top}}
'''Rogue Seven''' was the callsign used by certain fighter pilots of [[Rogue Squadron/Legends|Rogue Squadron]].

The pilots who have used the callsign include:
*[[Kasan Moor/Legends|Kasan Moor]] ([[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]])<ref name="RSVG">[[Star Wars: Rogue Squadron (video game)|''Star Wars: Rogue Squadron'']]</ref>
*[[Nala Hetsime]] ([[3 ABY/Legends|3 ABY]])<ref name="TEGTW">''[[The Essential Guide to Warfare]]''</ref>
*[[Keir Santage/Legends|Keir Santage]] (c. [[4 ABY/Legends|4 ABY]])<ref name="CWSE">''[[The Complete Star Wars Encyclopedia]]''</ref>
*[[Feylis Ardele]] (4&ndash;[[5 ABY/Legends|5 ABY]])<ref name="XWRS:M">[[X-Wing Rogue Squadron 28|''X-Wing Rogue Squadron'' 28]]</ref><ref name="XWRS:MR">[[X-Wing Rogue Squadron 35|''X-Wing Rogue Squadron'' 35]]</ref>
*[[Rhysati Ynr]] ([[6 ABY/Legends|6.5 ABY]])<ref name="XW:WG">''[[X-Wing: Wedge's Gamble]]''</ref>
*[[Tycho Celchu/Legends|Tycho Celchu]] ([[7 ABY/Legends|7 ABY]])<ref name="XW:TBW">''[[X-Wing: The Bacta War]]''</ref>
*[[Ran Kether]] ([[7 ABY/Legends|7 ABY]])<ref name="XW:SC">''[[X-Wing: Solo Command]]''</ref>
*[[Myn Donos]] ([[9 ABY/Legends|9 ABY]])<ref name="XW:IR">''[[X-Wing: Isard's Revenge]]''</ref>
*[[Tycho Celchu/Legends|Tycho Celchu]] ([[19 ABY/Legends|19 ABY]])<ref name="SOTP">''[[Specter of the Past]]''</ref>
*[[Ligg Panat]] ([[25 ABY/Legends|25 ABY]])<ref name="NJO:DT">''[[The New Jedi Order: Dark Tide I: Onslaught]]''</ref>
*[[Dakorse Teep]] ([[27 ABY/Legends|27 ABY]])<ref name="NJO:EL">''[[The New Jedi Order: Enemy Lines II: Rebel Stand]]''</ref>
